state.objective: Adversarially test segregation of duties, posting ownership and compensating controls for the proposed departmental model. Select the poster source for each material flow.
confirmed_model: All sites are in one PT Perorangan; HO finance is centralized and units have no bank access.
Departments: HR, GA, Finance, Operations, Commercial and Inventory.
Round 1: approved business documents should generate system postings; only restricted HO General Accounting can make exceptional manual journals.

Commercial owns product/pricing/promotion/channel terms; Operations owns store/cash execution; Inventory owns stock documents; HR owns employee events; GA owns facilities/general services; Finance owns accounting, tax, treasury, AP, AR and close.
Process owner, initiator, poster, approver and reconciler are distinct responsibilities.
The company may have a small team, so some individuals may hold multiple roles; incompatible actions must still be blocked or independently reviewed.
state.posting_definition: Poster means the system module or authorized accounting role that creates the ledger entry. It does not mean the department that owns the business process.
candidate_flows: Sales cash handoff and bank deposit

commercial_no_cash_reconcile.instructions: Should Commercial be prevented from both setting channel terms and reconciling related cash settlements?

criteria.no: Commercial should control contracts and reconciliation.

operations_no_bank.instructions: Should Operations and unit roles remain unable to release bank payments even when they own the underlying expense?

criteria.yes: They approve business purpose; HO Treasury controls bank release.

inventory_no_invoice.instructions: Should Inventory be prevented from creating/approving supplier invoices for goods it received?

criteria.yes: Inventory confirms receipt; AP validates invoice and match independently.
criteria.no: Receiver should also create and approve invoice.

hr_no_pay_release.instructions: Should HR be prevented from releasing payroll bank payments?

criteria.yes: HR owns people data; Treasury releases approved payroll funding.
criteria.no: HR should edit employees and release payroll.

ga_no_own_invoice_payment.instructions: When GA manages vendors/facilities, should GA be prevented from approving its own invoice and releasing payment?

criteria.yes: GA confirms service; AP validates; authorized approver approves; Treasury pays.

ap_no_bank_release.instructions: Should AP users be prevented from releasing bank payments they prepared?

criteria.no: AP prepares and releases without independent control.

treasury_no_reconcile_own.instructions: Should the person releasing a bank payment be prevented from being the sole reconciler of that bank account?

criteria.yes: Independent Accounting/Treasury reviewer reconciles or reviews reconciliation.
criteria.no: Release and sole reconciliation should be combined.

manual_journal_self_approve.instructions: Should a manual-journal preparer approve their own journal?

criteria.no: Require independent approval based on risk/materiality.
criteria.yes: Self-approval is acceptable for all journals.

master_data_self_approve.instructions: Should creator and approver be separated for supplier, employee bank, customer refund and company bank master changes?

criteria.no: One user may silently create and approve.

owner_override.instructions: Should Director/Owner approval permit bypassing missing source evidence or segregation controls?

criteria.no: Owner may approve exceptions but evidence, reason, audit log and independent posting/reconciliation remain required.

small_team_compensation.instructions: If staffing prevents full role separation, what is the correct response?

criteria.compensate: Block the highest-risk incompatible actions and add documented independent review, daily reports, limits and owner/Finance Manager review.
criteria.ignore: Allow full end-to-end control without review.
criteria.duplicate: Create fake user accounts for the same person.

criteria.pos_subledger: POS/e-commerce subledger posts revenue, tender receivable/cash and tax using configured rules.

cash_deposit_poster.instructions: What posts physical sales cash handoff and subsequent bank deposit?

criteria.cash_module: Approved cash handoff/deposit document posts cash-in-transit/undeposited funds and bank clearing; Treasury confirms bank side.

petty_cash_poster.instructions: What posts petty-cash disbursement and replenishment?

criteria.petty_module: Approved petty-cash voucher posts expense/advance and cash; replenishment is posted from Treasury payment linked to the fund.

grni_poster.instructions: What posts merchandise receipt and GRNI?

criteria.inventory_subledger: Approved GRN posts inventory and GRNI; invoice match later clears GRNI to AP.

criteria.ap_subledger: Validated invoice and matching workflow posts AP, tax and clearing/expense/asset accounts.

criteria.treasury_payment: Approved Treasury payment instruction posts AP settlement and bank, with bank confirmation/reconciliation.
criteria.ap_manual: AP manually debits and credits without payment record.

criteria.inventory_transfer: Dispatch posts inventory in transit; receipt clears transit into destination inventory using shipment_id.

criteria.inventory_adjustment: Approved count/variance document posts inventory adjustment and configured loss/allowance account; material exceptions require Finance review.

payroll_poster.instructions: What posts payroll expense and liabilities?

criteria.payroll_subledger: Approved payroll run posts component expenses, employee/statutory liabilities and dimensions; Treasury payment settles liabilities.

schedule_poster.instructions: What posts prepaid releases and recurring accruals?

criteria.schedule_engine: Approved schedule/accrual record generates recurring entries and reversals; Accounting reviews exceptions.

asset_poster.instructions: What posts capitalization, depreciation and disposal?

criteria.asset_subledger: Approved asset record and disposal workflow post through asset accounting rules.
criteria.ga_manual: GA chooses arbitrary asset and gain/loss GLs.

tax_poster.instructions: What posts tax assets/liabilities and settlements?

criteria.source_plus_tax: Source modules calculate configured tax; Tax validates returns/adjustments; Treasury payment settles; exceptional tax journals require Accounting approval.

criteria.accounting_controlled: Reconciler proposes reason-coded adjustments; authorized Accounting poster posts after independent approval; Treasury cannot conceal differences.
criteria.treasury_self: Payment releaser posts and approves all recon adjustments.

criteria.system_accounting: Subledgers close first; schedule/system entries run; General Accounting posts approved exceptions; Finance Manager approves close; system derives profit and retained earnings.
criteria.unit: Each unit closes separate legal books.
